interface.signature: status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int] -> int

preconditions.description: The lengths of status, candies, keys, and containedBoxes must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 1 for s in status)
preconditions.description: Each status value must be either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for c in candies)
preconditions.description: Each candy count must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b < len(status) for b in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each index in initialBoxes must be within the valid range of box indices.

postconditions.description: The returned value must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of candies collected.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if status[i] == 1)
postconditions.description: The total number of candies collected must equal the sum of candies in all open boxes.
